S-01.why: Brightline Electric, mobilizing Monday 12 October: certificate current to 1 March 2027 at $1,000,000 / $2,000,000, and Coverwell shows CG 20 10 and CG 20 37 on HC-GL-44810, each scheduling Kestrel Ridge and Alder Street Partners at 1180 Alder Street. No copy uploaded yet, which Exhibit D says does not matter once Coverwell confirms it

S-07.why: Marlow Concrete Cutting, mobilizing Thursday 15 October: its 6 October deficiency (no CG 20 37) was cured when CG 20 37 was added to GS-110-1876 effective 7 October, scheduling both organizations at 1180 Alder Street (Coverwell, and the agent's mail M-501); Exhibit D says a cured gap is approved, not noticed again

S-10.why: Halvorsen Elevator, mobilizing Thursday 5 November: limits $2,000,000 / $4,000,000, and both endorsements scheduling both organizations at 1180 Alder Street are on GS-110-2540. The certificate's blank additional insured box changes nothing: the endorsement on the policy is what counts

traps.S-02: Tallgrass Mechanical: the certificate's description claims completed operations, but PM-7731-GL carries CG 20 10 only, with no CG 20 37. A certificate confers no coverage
traps.S-03: Cobalt Fire Protection: 'additional insured per written contract' on the certificate, and no additional insured endorsement on GS-110-2291 at all
traps.S-04: Redfern Drywall: FW-GL-30087 expired on 30 September and the renewal is quoted, not bound; the certificate on file is stale
traps.S-05: Pinecrest Glazing: both endorsements schedule Kestrel Ridge only; Exhibit D needs Alder Street Partners named too
traps.S-06: Ironleaf Steel Erectors: approved on 2 October and on site since 5 October; approving it again is a duplicate
traps.S-08: Northbank Painting: $500,000 each occurrence and $1,000,000 aggregate, under Exhibit D's $1,000,000 / $2,000,000, and the subcontract allows no umbrella to make it up
traps.S-09: Quarry Hill Roofing: both endorsements are scheduled to 400 Harbor Boulevard, another project; nothing covers 1180 Alder Street

S-02.why: Tallgrass Mechanical, mobilizing Wednesday 14 October: CG 20 37 is missing from PM-7731-GL, whatever its certificate says

S-03.why: Cobalt Fire Protection, mobilizing Monday 19 October: neither CG 20 10 nor CG 20 37 is on GS-110-2291

S-04.why: Redfern Drywall, mobilizing Tuesday 13 October: its general liability policy expired on 30 September and no renewal is bound, so it has no policy in force to carry the endorsements

S-05.why: Pinecrest Glazing, mobilizing Monday 26 October: CG 20 10 and CG 20 37 schedule Kestrel Ridge but not the owner, Alder Street Partners LLC

S-08.why: Northbank Painting, mobilizing Monday 2 November: limits of $500,000 / $1,000,000 against the $1,000,000 / $2,000,000 Exhibit D requires, with no umbrella allowed to make them up

S-09.why: Quarry Hill Roofing, mobilizing Wednesday 21 October: both endorsements are limited to 400 Harbor Boulevard, so neither covers the Alder Street work

traps.S-01: Brightline Electric meets Exhibit D: both endorsements, both organizations, the right location, the limits
traps.S-06: Ironleaf Steel Erectors is approved, compliant and on site; there is nothing to notice
traps.S-07: Marlow's only gap, CG 20 37, was cured on 7 October; a second notice for it is wrong
traps.S-10: Halvorsen Elevator meets Exhibit D on its policy; a blank box on the certificate is not a deficiency in the insurance
